messages:
Tess: Saturday question: long group bike ride (35 miles, scenic route) or pancakes at Maple Diner and a lazy stroll? I can do either but need a headcount. :bike: :pancakes:
Ravi: Bike for sure. I need to earn my brunch. :sweat_smile:
Hannah: Pancakes for me. My legs are still protesting last weekend. Also maple syrup is a mood. :maple_leaf:
Diego: Im torn. If we do bike, can we have a pancake pit stop halfway? Compromise? :thinking_face:
Tess: Quick vote: B for bike, P for pancakes. Reply with letter. Ill lock plan by 6pm.
Ravi: B
Hannah: P
Diego: B (but will definitely eat pancakes if theres a pit stop)
Tess: Tally so far B 2, P 1. Looks like bike is edging out. If pancakes-pitstop is possible Ill route accordingly.
lunchbot: Draft event created: "Group Bike Ride (w/optional pancake stop)" Saturday 08:00. Organizer: Tess.
Hannah: If you do a pancake stop, Ill consider a shorter loop and join for pancakes only.
Ravi: Plan: meet at the waterfront bike racks at 7:45 for warm-up and coffee. Pack lights and a spare tube. Pancake stop at mile 18 if everyone agrees.
Diego: Ill bring the mini pump and energy bars. If anyone wants a gentler pace, say so now.
Tess: Gentle pace option available  no one left behind. If turnout is low well default to pancakes only and meet at Maple Diner 10am. Update here if youre coming.
Hannah: Keep me posted. If its pancakes-only Ill be there with syrup enthusiasm.
Ravi: See you early birds at 7:45. Pancake contingent, save me a plate if we split. :plate_with_cutlery:
